//Otlp: Where this instance exports. The same two things Snowglobe takes as -endpoint and -headers, in the same formats: a URL or a bare host:port, which is assumed to be TLS, and key=value pairs comma-separated. Leave Endpoint empty and runs still execute, they just do not go anywhere. The standard OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT and OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS are read when these are empty, so an environment already configured for OpenTelemetry needs nothing here.
